goal: Allow wallet logging to use proper severity levels instead of forcing every message to info level
Ensure source-location logging reports actual call sites while preserving wallet-name prefixes
agreement: Substantive support after concerns were resolved (adyshimony)
Objected to using fatal error level for non-fatal wallet issues, addressed by dropping commit (maflcko)
Interface suggestions and lifetime safety concerns were addressed (hodlinator, adyshimony)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it standardizes wallet logging on modern severity levels while preserving wallet prefixes
Fixes source location reporting in wallet logs without altering core wallet behavior
